== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-wed151662treadwelldroid-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[WED15-I662 'Treadwell' Droid (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same game text. This is a full card image, 350 × 490 pixels, with a white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The previous slip and the same area of this image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
